The main takeaway from our work is that
sorbitol dehydrogenases are a family of enzymes that can be used for the conversion of glucose and other sugars to their corresponding sugar alcohols and ketones, respectively.
the conversion of sugar to fructose and sugar alcohols is a normal liver function that is retained by HTC cells but not by adult hepatocytes in primary cultures.
the sorbitol pathway in HTC cells is not a result of a neoplastic transformation of hepatocytes, but a reflection of a retained normal liver metabolic pathway.
